judge.rationale: The candidate completely omits the actual implementation change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (moving `beforeSession` inside the `try` block), meaning its newly added acceptance test will fail and the bug remains unfixed. Additionally, the candidate failed to update `CHANGELOG.md`, which was an explicit requirement in the issue's acceptance criteria and even listed in the candidate's own `.lore/dod.md`. Instead of adding the test to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` file like the reference did, the candidate created a new test file and left `.lore/dod.md` in the diff. The only requirement properly completed was updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and writing a valid test case.
